notablePrerequisites: You have an additional permanent in hand that you can play this turn.
description:
Play the permanent from your hand, triggering Kodama of the East Tree on ETB.
With the Kodama of the East Tree trigger on the stack, sacrifice Lotus Bloom for {W}{W}{W} and spend two of it to activate Auriok Salvagers, returning Lotus Bloom to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Lotus Bloom onto the battlefield.
Pay {2} for the Mirrorworks trigger, creating a token copy of Lotus Bloom.
Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Before the trigger resolves, sacrifice the token Lotus Bloom copy for {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
